intro: MCP (Model Context Protocol) lets Claude Code call tools from external servers — databases, APIs, and custom services. Tools appear in Claude's tool list just like built-in tools.

sections.title: Quick Setup
sections.code:
# Add a server via CLI
claude mcp add postgres -- npx -y @modelcontextprotocol/server-postgres \
  --env POSTGRES_URL="$DATABASE_URL"

# List active servers
claude mcp list

# Remove a server
claude mcp remove postgres
